blocks.text: Meguiar's Ultimate Insane Shine Protectant Spray is here to create a rich, dark, and durable high gloss finish on unpainted vinyl, plastic, and rubber surfaces in and around your vehicle. This premium protectant boosts shine and guards against dirt, dust, and UV rays that create aging and fading. Our formula spreads easily without streaking. With a simple swipe you can create a dark, high gloss shine that improves the appearance of surfaces like dashboards, door panels, consoles, tires, wheel wells, and exterior trim. Get all the nooks and crannies of your vehicle with our shine protectant that cleans, shines, and protects all at once. It is a simple solution to a long-lasting, hassle-free surface shine for your exterior and interior surfaces. Meguiar's Ultimate Insane Shine Protectant Spray is good for spills, as well, protecting your car’s surfaces from liquids and quickly picking up what you drop. Each wipe goes a long way, giving your interior and exterior the best care you can give it in one tiny swipe. Not much effort is required to get an impeccable shine in an instant on your car’s interior and exterior surfaces. Just wipe and admire the results— it’s that easy. Trust Meguiar's for a radical, glossy shine on dashboards, door panels, consoles, tires, wheel wells, and more. Try the Shine Protectant Spray and see how it meets the needs of your car’s surfaces. The Ultimate Insane Shine Protectant Spray is effective and delivers the perfect shine for the interior and exterior of your vehicle, achieving that like-new shine on both the inside and outside surfaces of your vehicle.

items.label: LASTING AND GLOSSY SHINE
items.value: Insane shine and protective spray leaves unpainted vinyl, plastic, and rubber with a long-lasting high gloss shine, so you will not have to apply as often. Keep a longer surface shine with less work.

items.label: MULTI-STEPS IN ONE
items.value: To make treating your paint as easy as possible, Ultimate Insane Shine spray cleans, shines, and protects all at once. No hassle and a simple solution to a long-lasting surface shine for your exterior and interior surfaces.

items.label: NON-GREASY FINISH
items.value: The shine and protectant spray creates a dark, rich, high gloss shine without a greasy finish, hassle, or mess. Our simple, effective spray formula does the job on any unpainted vinyl, rubber, or plastic surfaces.

items.label: UV PROTECTION
items.value: There’s no need to worry about UV rays damaging your exterior or interior surfaces, or even fading them the slightest bit, as the formula contains UV absorbers. Our protectant formula has those strong UV rays covered.

items.label: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR
items.value: Shield and shine your ride inside and out with an all-in-one spray that is safe and effective. Great for use on interior and exterior vinyl, rubber, and plastics. No need to worry about fading or damage.
